text: She's been reading it for ten minutes.
note: Flat, dead, not even looking, quietly hurt. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Horror, quiet, turning to see his record wall getting soaked. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Upside down, laughing hard, to his friend, delighted. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Soaked, leaving, amazed, telling the host. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Leaving, grinning, pointing back inside. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Hugging the host, sincere, moved, almost tearful. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Leaving, hopeful, eager, backing out the door. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Sincere, helpful, totally serious, turning to his friend. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Grabbing her friend's arm, calm, dry, pulling him off. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
Wheezing, being choked, grinning, holding his phone up. Talk like a real person, casual and quick, natural, no long pauses between words.
